title: Sources: Nvidia employees, known for their fierce loyalty to Jensen Huang, have been left stunned and some are angry at the news of his extramarital affairs (Michael Acton/Financial Times)
summary: Michael Acton / Financial Times: Sources: Nvidia employees, known for their fierce loyalty to Jensen Huang, have been left stunned and some are angry at the news of his extramarital affairs — Chip giant co-founder's future as chief executive is uncertain following report of a second affair
